correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable settle-window skeleton: PR-number and env validation, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, head SHA checks before and after each GraphQL snapshot, five documented RESULT= branches with matching exit codes, and QUIET_ELAPSED based on latest allow-listed timestamps. Deductions for contract gaps visible in the diff: GraphQL calls pass -F repo="$REPO_NAME" where REPO_NAME is the full nameWithOwner string while OWNER is split correctly, so the repository name variable is almost certainly wrong for live gh GraphQL; CONVERGED fires whenever UNRESOLVED thread count is zero without checking that participating bots are terminal or that any bot participated on the current head (immediate converge on empty bot activity); and pagination is only handled by failing closed with API_ERROR when hasNextPage is true rather than continuing fetches.

quality.rationale: Implementation is readable and repo-consistent: set -euo pipefail, structured result_line/api_error helpers, jq-based state summarization, and a focused 12-file diff. Documentation is broadly synced across AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, agent-pipeline.md, scripts READMEs, and pr-resolve-all.md with helper preference, per-result handling, canonical allow-list pointer, and preserved time-based fallback. Minor deductions for ~320 lines of inline GraphQL/jq without extracted scripts/lib/jq helpers used elsewhere, bot-allowlist.txt adding cursor without an evident mirrored prompt bullet update in the diff hunk, and check module header referencing issue #374 instead of the task issue.

process.rationale: Diff stays focused on the helper, allow-list, bats tests, check wiring, and required doc/prompt companions with no AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or state-surface churn; objective process scored 15/15. pr-resolve-all.md prefers the helper while preserving the documented time-based fallback and renumbers round disciplines consistently. Required doc companions (2/2) and scripts README maintenance are evident in files-changed.txt.

reliability.rationale: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats adds four mock-gh scenario tests covering CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR with matching exit codes and RESULT= assertions; scripts/checks/106-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh wires run_bats_check and scripts/checks/105-scripts.sh includes syntax lint for the helper; objective bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed and test_wiring matched 2/2. Deductions because TIMEOUT is not fixture-tested, bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json with no runtime transcript, and the gh stub would not catch the live GraphQL repo-parameter wiring defect.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; mock-based contract tests are structurally credible from the diff but not runtime-verified in this bundle.
